description: The comparability families of this city's runs, declared once so the cross-run index (issue #77, src/analyse/build_run_index.py) can label every run directory mechanically instead of each reader re-deriving the boundaries from DECISIONS.md. A family boundary is a recorded model/data/network change after which nothing compares to what ran before it (DECISIONS.md 3.5 and the per-boundary entries below). Runs are assigned to the newest family whose from_launch stamp is <= their launch stamp; the overrides block wins where the record attributes a run explicitly or the launch date alone cannot settle it. THIS FILE IS A RECORD OF DECIDED BOUNDARIES, not a place to invent one - a new family is declared here in the same change as its DECISIONS.md entry.

F1-postrebuild-prerepair.label: post-rebuild, pre-repair (the 9.43 pilot family)
F1-postrebuild-prerepair.note: The issue #32 rebuild made everything before 16 Aug incomparable and results/ was already empty. Pilot arms conv1000_10pct / conv1000_25pct are this family's record.

F2-ride-binding.label: ride sampler + escort binding + age structure (9.44-9.47)
F2-ride-binding.note: The 18 Aug triple break. bind1000_25pct (20260818T235351) is the family's last and only completed arm.

F3-all-physical.label: freight + all-physical modes (9.49-9.55)
F3-all-physical.note: Freight changed the demand AND the model. No completed 1000-iteration arm: the 9.50 base arm was stopped by instruction, the 9.57 attempt stopped at iteration 136.

F4-walk-wedge.label: walk-wedge network repairs + lifts + PassingQ (9.58-9.63) - CLOSED
F4-walk-wedge.note: The CLOSED family whose record is the two completed arms 20260821T175907 / 20260821T180310 (9.64) - the pre-repair baseline every next-arm comparison is made against.

F5-ride-walk-repairs.label: round-trip ride bindings + short-trip mixture (9.68-9.69) - CLOSED UNMEASURED
F5-ride-walk-repairs.note: B2/plans/run inputs regenerated 24 Aug on the repaired mechanisms. NO CONVERGED ARM EVER RAN IN THIS FAMILY: the 4.6.9 arm was launch-blocked (9.72), and the 9.77 activation closed the family before it was measured. Its byte-identical inputs are regenerable by setting A.signals.representation=implicit_delay and A.crossings.representation=absent and removing taxi from the two RUN vocabularies, should the repairs-first ordering ever be revived. The 25 Aug batch was BUILT INERT inside this family (9.76).

F6-all-modes-activated.label: explicit signals + tram/bus priority + crossings + native dwell + taxi (9.77) - CURRENT
F6-all-modes-activated.note: The 9.77 activation boundary: A.signals.representation=explicit_signals (signal plans at the 14 corridor intersections, saturation-flow re-capacitation, each variant's own embedded tram delay removed from the schedule), A.crossings.representation=change_events (the two freight level crossings as a time-variant network), taxi in both RUN vocabularies (one blended priced mode), travel-time bin 300 s, usingFastCapacityUpdate=false, dwell carried by the signals-transformed schedules. ONE boundary per 9.75/9.76; run inputs regenerated 25 Aug. The 9.76 detached probe 20260825T033850 (launched 03:38) is F5; the activated probes from 09:44 on are F6.

aborted_20260818T162538_1000it_25pct.note: Dead launch, no artefacts, launched 18 Aug 16:25 - the record does not state whether the 9.44/9.45 landings preceded it that day, so its family is left unattributed rather than guessed.
